continuity_scope: Terms-only audit bound to Eberron: Rising from the Last War, Wizards of the Coast/D&D Beyond 2019 fifth-edition campaign sourcebook. Earlier editions, later playtests/updates, novels, games, home campaigns, and other licensed material are separate continuities or products and are not merged.

work_or_witnesses.work: Eberron: Rising from the Last War
work_or_witnesses.edition: Official D&D Beyond fifth-edition campaign sourcebook, 2019

coverage_rule: No characters are included. The accessible official source-page witness supplies setting/rules contents, but no stable claim-level profile of a named dramatic individual. Dragonmarks, ancestries, classes, factions, nations, deities, monsters, artifacts, places, and rules remain terms/context.
omissions: All named characters, deities, adventure NPCs, novel/game protagonists, and examples without a claim-level individual profile in the selected witness.
All earlier edition, Wayfinder's Guide, Exploring Eberron, playtest, novel/game, organized-play, and home-campaign material.
All D&D core rules or options that are not explicitly identified as Eberron-setting terminology in the selected source-page witness.
uncertainties: This 2019 sourcebook is a setting supplement for fifth edition, not core D&D canon and not a universal rules baseline.
Eberron publications have edition/product differences and later updates; no retcon reconciliation or global source hierarchy is asserted beyond this exact product's priority for included terms.
No distinct official Rising from the Last War errata witness was verified in this audit; later official adaptation guidance is recorded only as a product-boundary citation, not as setting canon.
The official page uses legacy 2019 ‘Races’ terminology in its contents. This audit preserves it as edition-specific rather than treating it as identical to 2024 core terminology.
evidence_basis: Official D&D Beyond source-page material identifies the 2019 campaign sourcebook and its Eberron setting/rules structure. It does not offer accessible claim-level named-character profiles, so no character or relationship records are warranted.

citations.locator: Official source page, introduction and table of contents
supports: 2019 sourcebook identity, Eberron campaign-sourcebook role, and setting terms including Khorvaire, Last War, Draconic Prophecy, and dragonmarks.
